title: Omar Lucio Joins RE/MAX Homestead! Another agent added to our growing team!
description:
We want to give a big welcome to Omar Lucio, Texas Realtor ®, to our team at RE/MAX Homestead!

Omar Lucio was born and raised in Central Texas. He graduated from Lampasas High School in 2015 and later went on to pursue a real estate license at Champions School of Real Estate in Austin. Omar Lucio finds great joy in understanding and educating his clients about real estate. He provides trustworthy experience, excellent communication, and overall knowledge of Central Texas. Omar knows each investment or sale is unique and requires attention to detail to make sure his clients are satisfied. Omar Lucio will make sure that it is stress-free and you enjoy your home buying or selling experience. He is happy to help with any questions or concerns you may have during your real estate journey. Omar Lucio enjoys barbecuing, playing sports, fishing, and enjoying time with family and friends in his spare time. He is family oriented, ambitious, genuine, and passionate about helping clients achieve their dreams of home ownership."
